batch.description: University of Chittagong (CU) A Unit question-bank collection — 2017-2018. 139 questions (Bangla 10, English 10, Physics 20, Chemistry 20, Biology 40, Higher Mathematics 20, ICT 19). Answer status: 114 verified / 25 unverified; this reflects answer-key review status, not an assertion that the question text is flawless. Import QA 2026-11-19: 22 subject labels corrected; cross-batch source IDs made importer-safe; source-conflicted keys remain unverified. This is a historical question-bank collection, not a claim that the pack count equals the official exam quota. the rest carry their best single-source key or no key, flagged per question. Explanations are null throughout (no cleanly alignable source). This session used a 140-question structure including an ICT section (তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি); the S1 parse holds 139 questions. The book grid splits Biology into Botany (20) + Zoology (20), concatenated here. 1 source-defect question(s) excluded (stem or options exist only as images in the source transcription; listed in the collection audit report). AI-solved keys (2026-11-18, not source-verified): 6. Keyless: 1. QA audit 2026-11-19: see QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
